verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is a SaaS ATS with several public APIs (Harvest, Job Board, Candidate Ingestion, Assessment, webhooks), so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows an OpenAPI/Swagger or equivalent spec being published. The probe found 404s on all common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on docs.greenhouse.io. Confidence is medium because a spec could exist at a path the probe did not try.
